verses: He lodged us in a spacious house, And plenteous was our fare. But now at every frugal meal There's not a scrap to spare. Alas! alas that this good man Could not go on as he began!
Four dishes on the mat the grain For every meal supplied. The change is great, from every meal We rise unsatisfied. Alas! alas that this good man Could not go on as he began!
